neighbours.label: an indefinite article ' a'/' an' introducing a predicate noun after a copula or 'as' (This is an…, You are a…, treated me as an…)
fire: Honestly, my brother is a talented carpenter.
Welcome to the site: this is an exclusive offer for members.
The doctor told him that he was an excellent patient.
In the story the old woman turns out to be a witch.
Her colleagues always treated her as an equal.
I think that you are a very patient teacher.
Everyone agrees the new library is a wonderful building.
After the war he became an engineer in Berlin.
quiet: Honestly, my brother bought a new saw for his workshop.
Welcome to the site: members get free shipping on every order.
The doctor gave him an injection before the operation.
In the story the old woman lives in a cottage by the woods.
Her colleagues always met her at a café near the office.
I think that you met my teacher at the school fair.
Everyone agrees the new library opened on a rainy day.
After the war he moved with his family to Berlin.

notes: The - pole fires on ' a' after a colon in titles; here near misses use ' a'/' an' as an object or after a preposition.
